trips.name: Seward train
trips.note: Column headed Thurs., Fri. and Sat. (no train number printed). Shown in Pacific time, two hours later than the Alaska (150th meridian) time printed.

trips.name: Seward train
trips.note: Column headed Wed., Thurs. and Fri. (no train number printed). It also serves the Alaska Steamship sailings from Seward (Brendan: it stands for the special from Anchorage). Shown in Pacific time, two hours later than the Alaska (150th meridian) time printed.

trips.name: Boat train
trips.note: Boat special for the Alaska Steamship arrival (the Baranof, Friday 9 July): times estimated from the printed rule (leaves 1 h 30 min after the ship arrives, not before 9.00 a.m.). Shown in Pacific time, two hours later than the Alaska (150th meridian) time printed.
